name.originalName: Asociación Mediterránea de Peritos de las Tecnologías de la Información y la Comunicación

interestRepresentative.goals: ASPERTIC is a Non-profit association that works towards a better justice system, a better use of technology and safeguarding privacy at national and European level. Members of the association are experts with a broad experience with ICTs (Information and communications technology), including copper pair technologies, robotics, biotechnology, and cybersecurity. As part of the association, members provide expert evidence before Courts and legislative bodies and at conferences, as well as training on their particular area of expertise.
interestRepresentative.EULegislativeProposals:
In the exercise of our association’s goal to work towards a better justice system, we pay particular attention to the following: - DIRECTIVE (EU) 2019/1158 OF THE EUROPEAN PARLIAMENT AND OF THE COUNCIL of 20 June 2019 on work-life balance for parents and carers and repealing Council Directive 2010/18/EU - DIRECTIVE 2006/54/EC OF THE EUROPEAN PARLIAMENT AND OF THE COUNCIL of 5 July 2006 on the implementation of the principle of equal opportunities and equal treatment of men and women in matters of employment and occupation (recast) - Council Directive 1999/70/EC of 28 June 1999 concerning the framework agreement on fixed-term work concluded by ETUC, UNICE and CEE - European Charter of Fundamental Rights - Proposal for a DIRECTIVE OF THE EUROPEAN PARLIAMENT AND OF THE COUNCIL on the protection of persons reporting on breaches of Union law
In the exercise of our association’s goal to work towards a better use of technology and safeguarding privacy, we pay particular attention to the following: - Regulation (EU) 2016/679 of the European Parliament and of the Council of 27 April 2016 on the protection of natural persons with regard to the processing of personal data and on the free movement of such data, and repealing Directive 95/46/EC (General Data Protection Regulation) - The EU Cybersecurity Act
The association is awaiting selection to be a member of the STAKEHOLDER CYBERSECURITY CERTIFICATION GROUP of the European Commission.
interestRepresentative.communicationActivities: Members of the association act as expert speakers at congresses and panel discussions on several topics related to the goals of the association, including some bodies of the European Union. The association also provides expert technical and legal advice to Members of the European Parliament. Aspertic provided advice in relation to the directive on the protection of whistleblowers.

interestRepresentative.registrationCategory: Non-governmental organisations, platforms and networks and similar
interestRepresentative.goals: Our mission is to protect nature and a healthy environment for future generations both in Czechia and abroad. In our activities, we rely on three components - public involvement in the decision-making process, expert opinions and justified requests, and media coverage of the problems. In the long-term, we are promoting less waste and hazardous substances, wild living rivers and diverse nature, and the right of citizens to make decisions about the environment.
interestRepresentative.EULegislativeProposals: Main Eu Legislation proposals: We work on chemicals legislation and specific products legislation in relation to chemicals and the European Strategy for Sustainability of Chemicals and Sustainable Products Initiative + specific EU legislation: REACH, POPs regulation, Toys directive, ROHS directive etc. We work on waste legislation (Waste Framework directive, European Pollution and Transfer Register (EPRTR), European Union Emissions Trading System, Circular Economy Action Plan and Waste Shipment directive) We also comment on the EU position in relation to international agreements including Stockholm, Basel, Minamata and Aarhus Convention. Additionally, we comment on Water Framework directive, Natura 2000. Generally, we also work on implementing EU Green Deal priorities in relation to major campaing goals of Arnika.
interestRepresentative.EUSupportedForumsAndPlatforms: EU POPs regulation competent authorities group
interestRepresentative.communicationActivities: In relation to EU legislation proposals, we organize webinars and face to face meetings with Members of European Parliament and EU Commission staff, send letters and emails to EU authorities, comment on public consultations, organize conferences and happenings.
